content.text: Submitted. The repaired proposal keeps the locked "deviation" status at the fallback level and now makes only two minimal changes: a lesser-of limb in Section 4.2(a) capping the Termination Payment at 3 months' Section 3.1 fees, and a short new 4.2(d) confirming it is the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company on termination. The earlier broad exception for termination under Section 1.6 or for HDI's breach — a separate commercial win not needed for the fallback — has been removed, and both official minimality gates now pass.
